task: Making a pom-pom pencil topper (tying a pom-pom to a pencil)
query: How do I tie a pom-pom to a pencil to make a pom-pom pencil topper?

goal.title: Make a white yarn tassel on a pencil
goal.description: Pull and cut a length of white yarn, form loops around fingers while holding a pink pencil, gather and tie the loops into a tassel, then cut and trim the dangling yarn. The original fine track covers only the first portion of the craft.
goal.final_state: In the full video a trimmed white tassel hangs from the pink pencil; at the last annotated boundary trimming is still in progress.
procedure: Pull out white yarn, cut a length and prepare a loop.
Position the yarn on the pink pencil and wrap multiple loops around left fingers.
Slide loops together, tie and tighten the yarn around the bundle.
Cut loop ends and trim the fringe, repeatedly checking the hanging tassel.

phases.description: Yarn is pulled from the ball, cut with scissors, folded and pinched into a loop before the pink pencil is picked up.
The pencil is held horizontally while repeated passes of white yarn form a bundle around the left fingers.
Hands pinch the loops, remove them from the fingers and pull yarn around the gathered bundle near the pencil.
The short preserved segments show repeated threading, pulling, pinching and tightening of yarn, then rotating the pencil and spreading the hanging loops.
Scissors are picked up, positioned around loops and used to snip yarn ends while the left hand rotates the bundle. Trimming continues beyond the source fine track.
